716550101.text: Ah, you arrived quickly. Good, good.

716550105.text: I asked you to come here so I could give you a little gift.

716550106.text: I do not know if I told you before, but these abodes are private spaces created by the adepti for themselves.

716550107.text: Most adepti will use certain methods to seal their abode away from the rest of the world to ensure its purity and avoid being disturbed.

716550108.text: Afterward, adepti would create a "Realm Dispatch" for those they wished to invite into their abode.

716550109.text: This Realm Dispatch bears signatures of the abode's adeptal energy and that of the adeptus themselves. As such, anyone who has this dispatch can enter or exit the abode freely.

716550110.text: Before, this abode was in an incomplete, embryonic state. Those whom you invited into it would only have been able to exit and enter together with you, rather than remain for long periods.

716550111.text: But now... Well, take this Realm Dispatch that I have created for you and hold it in your hand — tightly, now.

716550104.text: Hmm? No, of course not. Why was that your first reaction...?
